conviction_note: Pre-revenue business update. The stock fell 29% in five sessions with no company news (AI-tech sell-off on Oct 30, then the midterm sweep on Nov 4-5) and now trades at about 1.1x June tangible book, close to cash. Against that sits an undisclosed draw on the new $1B ATM, which the 10-Q cover will reveal, plus an H2 capex catch-up. Findings sum to -0.5. The scaled number is +0.72 (p_up 53 x abs 12): a slight lean that a capitulation low into a print with ~$3.2B+ cash rebounds, cut toward 50 after LESSONS rule 5, because 'the drawdown had no company cause' is not evidence of a bounce. The two numbers disagree in sign because the lean in p_up rests on positioning and flow, which I sized small as findings, while the document-backed findings (ATM, capex pace) lean negative.
bar: Consensus Q3 2026 EPS -$0.27 and revenue $1.03M (TipRanks, 2026-11-04, https://tipranks.com/news/oklo-stock-could-move-12-after-q3-earnings-say-options-traders); Earnings Whispers shows -$0.25 (https://beta.earningswhispers.com/go/w/OKLO). The two sources agree within $0.02. The stock does not trade on EPS. The lines that matter are company guidance from the Q2 call (https://www.marketbeat.com/instant-alerts/oklo-q2-earnings-call-highlights-2026-08-08/): 2026 operating cash use $120-150M (raised from $80-100M), 2026 PP&E capex $400-500M (raised from $350-450M), Aurora-INL startup 2028, Groves commissioning about 12 months out, first isotope revenue early 2027, and no Aurora-INL total cost given. Piper Sandler expects fuller cost guidance only at a spring-2027 capital markets day. Q2 EPS was -$0.28 against an estimate of about -$0.12 to -0.16, so the loss line has missed before.
positioning_check: Short interest: 26.0M shares, 2.4 days to cover, at the 2026-08-14 settlement, down from 30.3M and 3.3 days on 2026-07-31 (per search-result summary of FINRA-based data pages; curvedtrading.com and nasdaq.com short-interest pages refused fetch). That is about 14% of the ~186M shares outstanding on 2026-08-04 (10-Q cover). The sweep cites ~15.6% of float, 27.2M shares and 1.9 days in July 2026 (equibles.com). Barchart put it at 16.45% of shares through April 2026 (https://www.barchart.com/story/news/1752698/the-biggest-catalyst-for-oklo-stock-may-not-be-earnings-but-a-brewing-short-squeeze). No October settlement was found. Skew: the baseline's 25-delta skew is null. Put/call open interest is 0.70 (calls outnumber puts). ATM IV is 129%, the straddle 16.2%, the event-implied move 13.79%. TipRanks quotes ±12.18% at $23.49 on 2026-11-04. The market makes no directional statement through skew. The short base is moderately crowded, which shrinks any negative.

findings.finding: At $18.95 Oklo trades about 1.09x its June 30 tangible book ($17.34/share on 185.09M shares, Sept 11 424B5) and close to cash. June 30 cash and marketable securities were $3.006B. About 7.3M ATM shares sold in Q3 at ~$44 added ~$320M gross. Q3 opex plus capex burn is roughly $150-200M. Sept 30 cash should therefore print at about $3.1-3.2B before any new-ATM sales, against a market cap of about $3.5-3.8B (EV well under $1B for a company with a DOE-approved PDSA, a critical isotope reactor and a construction site). The print restates that cash figure in the headline.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No clean history on the cash line. On Q2 (2026-08-07), with ~$3.0B cash shown, the stock rose about 2-7% intraday by conflicting reports (https://parameter.io/oklo-oklo-stock-surges-7-despite-expanded-q2-losses-on-revenue-beat/). The last four reactions averaged 6.63% absolute (TipRanks).
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: anyone can compute cash per share. The last five sessions' 29% fall came on AI-tech and midterm macro with no company news (TIKR, Nov 4-5), and sector selling does not recompute each name's balance sheet. If the market were anchoring on the cash floor, the name would have stopped falling near tangible book instead of making four straight 52-week lows into the print.
findings.independence: The June cash figure is in the 10-Q (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001849056/000162828026054571/oklo-20260630.htm). The Q3 ATM figure (7.3M shares, ~$320M) comes from the Sept 11 8-K (17,971,448 shares sold under the May program) less the 10.7M sold in Q2. Same filing family, so this is one finding. TIKR (2026-11-05) independently notes market value of at least $3.8B against $3.0B cash.

findings.finding: The 5-day -29% and 20-day -45% fall into the print has no company-specific cause. Drivers named in the press: the Oct 30 AI-stock sell-off on weak tech earnings, nuclear-group selling on Nov 2, and the Nov 4-5 Democratic-sweep sell-off in AI power names (-6% Nov 4, -10% Nov 5 to ~$20). Cameco fell 12% over the Oct 27 - Nov 3 stretch. Sell-side targets were cut into the print (Piper $49 from $55 on Oct 19, Barclays $59 from $76 on Oct 20, B. Riley $61 from $92 on Oct 28, Wedbush assumed at $36 on Nov 2), so the bar for the business update has already been marked down. Short interest is about 14% of shares.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None on this line in the baseline (one usable prior print, -6.41% on 2025-03-24 amc). Q2 2026 sold off into the print (-45% YTD before it) and then rose on the day.
findings.why_not_priced: This is positioning and flow, not a fact the market lacks. It matters only if the macro selling has overshot what an on-track update would justify. If it were priced as pure macro, the stock would have tracked the group; instead it fell ~15% in two sessions against Comfort Systems' -15% on the first day alone, so the move looks like group de-risking. Sized small because rule 5 warns that 'no company cause' does not imply a bounce.
findings.independence: https://www.tikr.com/blog/oklo-sinks-14-in-a-week-to-a-new-52-week-low-is-the-selling-overdone (2026-11-04: no company news, Cameco -12%); https://www.tikr.com/blog/oklo-sinks-6-comfort-systems-usa-down-15-as-democratic-sweep-rattles-ai-power-stocks-a-negative-surprise; analyst cuts at https://www.tikr.com/blog/oklo-has-lost-83-in-a-year-piper-sandler-sees-82-upside and https://www.tikr.com/blog/oklo-has-lost-83-in-a-year-barclays-sees-117-upside. Most of these sources are one publisher (TIKR).

findings.finding: Usage of the new $1B ATM opened on 2026-09-11 is undisclosed and will appear in the 10-Q (subsequent events and the cover share count, last 186,017,650 on 2026-08-04). Oklo's record is fast, full usage: $1.9B raised in H1 2026, and the entire $1B May program (17.97M shares) used by Sept 10, under four months. Its June cash already covers the burn through 2028 by analysts' numbers. Sales at $20-40 in Sept-Oct would therefore read as dilution ahead of need rather than funding of a visible ramp.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The stock slid the morning the new $1B ATM was announced on Sept 11 (https://www.tikr.com/ja/blog/oklo-stock-slides-equity-distribution-agreement). A Q2-timed ATM item coincided with a ~4% pre-market dip to $38.26 (conflicting reports). On Q2 day itself the stock still rose with $1.9B YTD raises disclosed.
findings.why_not_priced: Nobody outside the company knows how many shares were sold since Sept 11. If the market assumed heavy usage, sell-side previews would carry a share-count estimate; TIKR's preview explicitly says it has no figure and calls 'heavy sales at current prices' the bear tell. Financing question answered: the money would fund Aurora-INL, the fuel facility and Groves, but capex is running behind guide (H1 $126.9M of $400-500M) and cash covers the burn to 2028, so new sales have no corroborated near-term need. The sign is negative, shrunk for the ~14% short interest and because a light-usage disclosure flips it positive.
findings.independence: The 10-Q (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001849056/000162828026054571/oklo-20260630.htm) gives the 10.7M Q2 ATM shares and the 186.0M cover count. The analyst burn of $6.3B 2026-2030 against $3.0B cash is from TIKR (https://www.tikr.com/blog/oklo-sinks-14-in-a-week-to-a-new-52-week-low-is-the-selling-overdone). It shares the cash arithmetic with finding 1, but the two are opposite readings of different quantities: cash level versus share issuance since Sept 11.

findings.finding: Capex is running behind the raised guide. H1 2026 PP&E spend was $126.9M against a full-year guide of $400-500M, which needs $273-373M in H2 (at least ~$137M a quarter). In August the Aurora-INL reactor excavation was still not complete. Q3 will show whether the build accelerated, or the guide gets trimmed, which reads as schedule slip against the 2028 Aurora-INL start. Operating cash use was $65.5M in H1 against a $120-150M guide, so it is on pace and inside guide (toward 0).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: At Q2 the capex and opex guides were raised and the stock rose on the day, so this name has not punished spending increases. No instance of a capex cut is on record.
findings.why_not_priced: The H2 run-rate gap is arithmetic on public numbers that previews (TIKR) note but do not resolve. If the market expected a cut and slip, the option market would carry a downside skew, and it carries none (put/call OI 0.70). Sized small because a trim can also be read as capital discipline.
findings.independence: The H1 figure of $126.9M also appears at https://www.tikr.com/blog/oklo-has-lost-83-in-a-year-barclays-sees-117-upside. Excavation status (Aug) is from the same TIKR piece. Same company-guidance source as the bar.

findings.finding: Piper Sandler raised its assumed Oklo plant build cost to $7,000/kW from $4,000 (target cut to $49 on Oct 19) and expects real cost guidance only at a spring-2027 capital markets day. Any Aurora-INL cost figure Oklo gives on Friday below that marked-down bar would surprise up. If, as Piper expects, none is given, the item is 0.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The CFO declined to give an Aurora-INL total cost on the Q2 call and the stock still rose on the day. No history of a cost disclosure.
findings.why_not_priced: Whether a cost is disclosed is unknown. The sell-side has lowered its assumptions (B. Riley -34% on target, Wedbush to $36), so the hurdle for a cost number is lower than a month ago. If a disclosure were expected, previews would carry a cost figure as the bar; they carry only Piper's estimate.
findings.independence: TIKR's Nov 5 preview also lists the Aurora cost as an open item (https://www.tikr.com/blog/oklo-sank-10-a-day-after-the-democratic-sweep-rattled-ai-power-stocks-heres-what-fridays-report-has-to-settle). Same publisher.

findings.finding: An NRC staff letter of 2026-10-14 (ML26238A237) returns observations from the NRC's audit of Oklo's Aurora-INL DOE PDSA submittals. It confirms Oklo plans to file an NRC license application for Aurora-INL after DOE authorization, and says the audit gave 'early identification of issues that need to be addressed prior to NRC licensing'. The enclosure with the observations (ML26238A238) was not retrievable (404), so their severity is unknown.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Regulatory items have moved the stock: a +5% reported move on a federal safety clearance (parameter.io), and a 15% slide on the NRC timeline being years away (particlenews). No reaction to this letter is recorded.
findings.why_not_priced: Primary NRC document with no wire coverage found. Management may be asked about it on the call. If it had been read as adverse, it would have been reported, and no story ties a move to it.

findings.finding: Insider Form 4s into the print are routine. CFO Richard Craig Bealmear exercised and sold 16,727 shares at $25.55 on 2026-11-02 under a 10b5-1 plan adopted 2025-09-22 (he still holds 472,630 shares and 569,827 options). The Chief of Staff's Oct 29 sale was a 1,034-share RSU sell-to-cover. Form 144s were filed through Nov 2. There are no open-market buys.
findings.why_not_priced: Public on EDGAR and on MarketBeat (https://marketbeat.com/instant-alerts/insider-oklo-nyse-oklo-stock-insider-richard-craig-bealmear-sells-16727-shares-2026-11-04). The only information is the absence of any insider buying at a 52-week low, which is weak.

findings.finding: Centrus, Oklo's HALEU counterparty under a Q2 LOI for up to five Aurora cores and reloads from 2029, reported Q3 on 2026-11-04. The release does not mention Oklo, so no definitive Oklo supply agreement was announced by the counterparty. It also says DOE's proposed FY2027 budget carries no further funding for the HALEU Operation Contract. Oklo's initial Aurora-INL fuel comes from EBR-II material, so near-term exposure is limited.
findings.why_not_priced: A counterparty that has spoken since Oklo last did. The DOE HALEU funding point is buried in Centrus's backlog discussion. Proxy for Oklo's fuel path, not confirmed by Oklo, so sized small.
findings.independence: Oklo's own fuel plan (EBR-II initial cores, Centrus LOI) is from the Q2 call: https://www.marketbeat.com/instant-alerts/oklo-q2-earnings-call-highlights-2026-08-08/

outside_window.finding: Fuller plant-cost, PPA and fuel guidance is expected at Oklo's spring-2027 capital markets day (Piper Sandler), not at this print.
First isotope revenue from the Idaho Radiochemistry Laboratory is expected in early 2027. Groves commissioning runs about 12 months from August 2026.

baseline_tension: No skew to agree or disagree with (null, put/call OI 0.70). The run-up is deeply negative (-29% 5d, -45% 20d, at the 52-week low), and my slight positive lean in p_up runs against that momentum, so it is held near 50. The negative findings (ATM, capex pace) run with the run-up and are shrunk for a short interest of about 14%.
lessons_applied: Rule 5 (an unexplained drawdown is not evidence of a symmetric or rebound reaction): positioning/flow finding cut +0.8 to +0.4, and p_up cut 55 to 53.
'Cheap is not a finding', plus rule 1: near-cash valuation finding cut +0.8 to +0.6.
Rules 4 and 7: the ATM finding was asked what the money buys (capex behind guide, cash covers to 2028, so no corroborated need) and kept negative, then shrunk -1.0 to -0.8 for ~14% short interest.
Rule 6: capex-pace finding cut -0.5 to -0.4. Opex on pace and inside guide, sized at 0 within it.

Base-rate rebuild (baseline_history_trustworthy false): used TipRanks' four prior reactions (avg 6.63%, range 5.39-8.12) beside the 13.79% event-implied move. abs_move_pct held at 12, below implied and above history, with no shrink for sign uncertainty.
Left standing: the cost-disclosure (+0.3), NRC letter (-0.2), insider (-0.1) and Centrus (-0.3) findings.
